image_description: A close-up shot of a child's arm holding an orange bubble wand, blowing soap bubbles. Several bubbles are visible in mid-air against a yellow wooden wall and a green window frame background. A small yellow rubber duck is perched on the child's wrist/arm area. The head of another person with brown hair is visible in the bottom right foreground.
